title: Tall Complexity One Spaces with k-colorable Skeleton
summary: Tall complexity one $T$-spaces are Hamiltonian $T$-spaces $(M,ω,Φ)$ such that $\frac{1}{2}\dim M -\dim T=1$ and the symplectic quotient at each moment value is a surface. The skeleton of a complexity one $T$-space is an important invariant in the classification and encodes the information about non-generic orbits. In this paper, we study properties of the skeleton of a compact, connected tall complexity one $T$-spaces.
